// Phase 3D.5 — ADMIN "Prepare Access Upsert"
const j = $input.first().json;
if (!j.access_registry_write || !j.access_upsert) {
  return [{ json: { ...j, sheets_access_mutate: false, sheets_event_mutate: false } }];
}
const r = j.access_upsert;
const ev = j.access_event || {};
return [{ json: {
  ...j,
  sheets_access_mutate: true,
  sheets_event_mutate: Boolean(j.access_event),
  telegram_user_id: String(r.telegram_user_id || ''),
  telegram_user_hash: String(r.telegram_user_hash || ''),
  telegram_username: String(r.telegram_username || ''),
  display_name: String(r.display_name || ''),
  role: String(r.role || ''),
  status: String(r.status || ''),
  first_seen_at: String(r.first_seen_at || ''),
  last_seen_at: String(r.last_seen_at || ''),
  requested_at: String(r.requested_at || ''),
  approved_at: String(r.approved_at || ''),
  approved_by: String(r.approved_by || ''),
  revoked_at: String(r.revoked_at || ''),
  revoked_by: String(r.revoked_by || ''),
  source: String(r.source || ''),
  notes: String(r.notes || ''),
  ts: String(ev.ts || new Date().toISOString()),
  opaque_user_ref: String(ev.opaque_user_ref || ''),
  event: String(ev.event || ''),
  prior_role: String(ev.prior_role || ''),
  prior_status: String(ev.prior_status || ''),
  new_role: String(ev.new_role || ''),
  new_status: String(ev.new_status || ''),
  actor_ref: String(ev.actor_ref || ''),
  event_source: String(ev.source || ''),
  outcome: String(ev.outcome || ''),
  detail: String(ev.detail || ''),
}}];
